title: Metal Sandbox: Isolated Execution and Command Scheduling for GPU Coding Agents on Apple Silicon
abstract: arXiv:2611.17294v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: On-device inference requires kernels that make effective use of local accelerators. Efficient training and evaluation of models that generate Apple Metal kernels benefit from native macOS tools and concurrent agent sessions. These sessions alternate between model requests, development commands, and GPU execution, leaving GPU capacity idle for much of a rollout. We present Metal Sandbox, infrastructure that combines restricted per-instance file access, native command execution, and command-level scheduling across interconnected Macs. Each agent retains its workspace and private development environment. Parallel commands can run concurrently, while serial commands share one execution slot per node; eligible waiting commands can migrate to available Macs and return results to the original agent. Integration with Harbor supports task execution, automatic verification, and rollout collection through a common workflow. Controlled experiments

translated_title: Metal Sandbox：面向 Apple Silicon 上 GPU 编程智能体的隔离执行与命令调度
translated_abstract: 设备端推理需要能够充分利用本地加速器的内核。对生成 Apple Metal 内核的模型进行高效训练与评估，得益于原生 macOS 工具和并发的智能体会话。这些会话在模型请求、开发命令和 GPU 执行之间交替进行，导致 GPU 容量在一次 rollout 的大部分时间处于空闲状态。我们提出了 Metal Sandbox，这是一种基础设施，它结合了受限的每实例文件访问、原生命令执行，以及跨互联 Mac 集群的命令级调度。每个智能体保留自己的工作区和专用开发环境。并行命令可以并发运行，而串行命令在每个节点共享一个执行槽位；符合条件的等待命令可以迁移到可用的 Mac 上，并将结果返回给原始智能体。通过与 Harbor 的集成，支持通过统一的工作流实现任务执行、自动验证和 rollout 收集。受控实验
tldr: 该论文提出 Metal Sandbox，一种在 Apple Silicon 上为 GPU 代码生成智能体提供隔离执行环境和跨互联 Mac 的命令级调度的基础设施，通过并发执行与命令迁移机制提升 GPU 利用率和训练评估效率。
en_tdlr: The paper presents Metal Sandbox, an infrastructure that provides isolated execution environments and command-level scheduling across interconnected Macs for GPU coding agents on Apple Silicon, improving GPU utilization through concurrent execution and command migration.
